description: External action policy: what reaches outside the repository or the product, and what that requires. Consumers: external-action-check, tool-router, approval-router and the notification and email agents.

classes.requires: external-send approval under the sending policy
external-send-irreversible approval bound to the package hash and a configured provider
signature approval bound to the document hash
payment approval and a configured payout provider

rules: a sent message cannot be recalled; compensation is a recorded correction message
an unconfigured provider is reported unavailable and never simulated
recipients come from validated records and roles, never from free text
every external action is recorded with its approval reference
